tagline.text: Every space starts with documents that everyone involved can rely on. Those are the documents I create.

services.title: More planning capacity when several projects run at once.
services.lead: Stand builders, agencies and interior fit-out companies reach their limits with parallel projects, staff shortages and technically demanding tasks. As an external planner and project controller I take over clearly defined parts of your project, backed by more than 20 years of experience in the trade fair and event sector. Production, transport, assembly, structural engineering, permits and electrical work are carried out by qualified specialist partners.

trust.title: One point of contact
trust.text: for planning, documents and coordination. You talk to me directly, not through intermediaries.

trust.title: More than 20 years of experience
trust.text: in the trade fair and event sector, trained as a technical draughtsman in wood technology and certified exhibition and event project manager (IHK).

trust.title: Clearly defined scope
trust.text: I agree the scope, correction rounds and deadlines in writing beforehand. Extra work and travel only by arrangement.

package.title: Project by project or as a monthly quota.
package.subtitle: Planning capacity in the amount your project needs right now.
package.text: You send me a brief, I estimate the effort and propose scope, deliverables and deadlines. After that I work project by project or within a monthly quota with fixed hours, response times and correction rounds. My capacity is limited; I only accept projects I can handle with care.

network.title: Specialist partners for execution.
network.text: I plan and coordinate; qualified specialist companies carry out the work. In the basic model you commission larger production and assembly services directly from your partners; on request I liaise with them and prepare their documents. CL Projektwerk is not a production workshop and does not act as a general contractor that finances projects.

single.title: Exactly the service you are missing.
single.text: You have a team but too little planning capacity? Then book only the area you need, for example production drawings for one project or schedule control for a trade fair appearance.

tech.title: Technical planning
tech.text: Based on your brief I create dimensioned detail and production drawings, part lists and interface documents. You receive documents your production partners can work with, and you save internal planning hours.
points: Interface documents for trades and partners
tech.task: Task: translate your brief into unambiguous technical documents.
tech.result: Result: drawings, lists and interfaces in an agreed status.
tech.benefit: Benefit: fewer queries in production and more time for your clients.

prep.title: Work preparation
prep.text: I prepare your project for execution: material and quantity overviews, partner-specific production documents and procurement and schedule planning. Everyone involved knows what is needed, when and in what quantity.
prep.task: Task: organise materials, quantities and dates for execution.
prep.result: Result: overviews and documents compiled for each partner.
prep.benefit: Benefit: fewer shortages and schedule surprises during build-up.

control.title: Project control
control.text: I keep budget and schedule clear, compare quotations, coordinate trades and document approvals and changes. Decisions stay with you; I prepare them so they can be made quickly.
points: Quotation comparisons and coordination of trades
control.task: Task: keep an overview of costs, dates and agreements.
control.result: Result: current overviews and documented decisions.
control.benefit: Benefit: relief with parallel projects and clear traceability.

concept.title: Design and presentation
concept.text: I develop stand and space concepts and create visualisations and print-ready graphics. The scope and the number of correction rounds are agreed in advance so that effort and result stay predictable.
points: Print-ready graphics with agreed correction rounds
concept.task: Task: show an idea so that you and your clients can decide.
concept.result: Result: concept, visualisations and print data in the agreed scope.
concept.benefit: Benefit: early decisions based on understandable images and plans.

reuse.title: Reuse planning
reuse.text: I record existing components, plan variants for new uses and maintain material and storage information. This lets you deliberately reuse what you already have instead of planning from scratch every time.
reuse.task: Task: record existing components and make them usable for new builds.
reuse.result: Result: inventory list, variants and storage information.
reuse.benefit: Benefit: less re-planning and material use for recurring builds.

about.name: Christof Laufersweiler
about.role: Planning and project control for exhibition stands, brand spaces and interior fit-out
about.text: I am Christof Laufersweiler and have worked in the trade fair and event sector for more than 20 years. I trained as a technical draughtsman specialising in wood technology, and later added project management in exhibition stand construction, employed managing director of a stand-building company and an IHK certificate as exhibition and event project manager. With CL Projektwerk I offer external planning and project capacity in Leipzig for stand builders, agencies, interior fit-out companies and exhibitors who need extra hands with expertise. Most recently, I worked as a Senior Project Manager at C3 EXPO GmbH from November 2025 to October 2026.
about.close: You keep the decisions. I provide documents, overview and coordination.

seo.title: Technical planning, work preparation and project control for exhibition stands and interior fit-out.
seo.intro: CL Projektwerk is an external planning and project office in Leipzig. I support stand builders, agencies, interior fit-out companies and mid-sized exhibitors with exhibition stand planning: dimensioned production documents, work preparation, external project control, concepts and reuse planning. Specialist partners carry out the work; I deliver planning and coordination.

blocks.title: Technical exhibition planning
blocks.text: From the brief come dimensioned detail and production drawings, part lists and interface documents. Your production partners can work with them, without your team having to create every drawing itself.

blocks.title: Work preparation for exhibition stands and brand spaces
blocks.text: Material and quantity overviews, documents for each production partner and procurement and schedule planning turn drawings into a process that can be organised.

blocks.title: External project control
blocks.text: Budget and schedule overviews, quotation comparisons, coordination of trades and documented approvals create clarity, especially when several projects run at once.

blocks.title: Concept, presentation and reuse
blocks.text: Stand and space concepts, visualisations and print-ready graphics help with coordination. Reuse planning records existing components and plans variants for new uses.

faq.a: It depends on scope, deliverables and deadlines. After a short brief you receive an individual quotation for the project or for a monthly quota.

faq.q: When should I get in touch?
faq.a: Ideally as soon as the task and deadline are fixed, because my monthly planning capacity is limited. I check short-notice requests against my current workload.

faq.q: Can I book just a single service?
faq.a: Yes. Technical planning, work preparation, project control, design and presentation or reuse planning can each be booked individually.

faq.q: Do you also manufacture and assemble?
faq.a: No. Qualified specialist partners carry out manufacturing, transport, assembly, structural engineering, permits and electrical work. You normally commission larger services directly; I plan and coordinate.

faq.q: Are on-site meetings or travel possible?
faq.a: Planning is mostly done from Leipzig. We agree on-site meetings and travel in advance, and additional services are agreed separately.

faq.q: Do you offer web design or automation?
faq.a: That is not one of my main services. My focus is planning and controlling exhibition stand, brand space and interior fit-out projects.
